description:
KHAI Designsz Ambassador Program

KHAI Designsz is a cutting-edge creative agency specializing in graphic design, branding, digital marketing, motion graphics, and web development. Known for its bold and innovative designs, KHAI Designsz also offers KHAI Designsz Apparel, a streetwear brand featuring the Da Link Collection, which symbolizes connection, unity, and strength.

Product Description:

As a KHAI Designsz Brand Ambassador, you will promote a diverse range of services and products, including:

  • Apparel: T-shirts, hoodies, and crew-neck sweaters with unique chain-inspired graphics.
  • Graphic & Web Design: High-quality branding materials, logos, Shopify and Acquity website designs.
  • Marketing Services: Digital marketing strategy, motion graphics, and promotional videos.
  • Flyer Design & Motion Graphics: Dynamic content creation for businesses and influencers.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

  • Exclusive Discounts: Ambassadors get 20-35% off all KHAI Designsz services.
  • Personalized Growth: Gain exposure while promoting high-quality creative services and apparel.
  • Creative Support: Access to custom branding materials to enhance personal and business marketing.
  • Community-Driven: Represent a brand that values connection, resilience, and unity.

Payment Terms:

  • Commission-Based Earnings: Ambassadors may earn commissions on successful referrals.
  • Discounted Services: Enjoy exclusive savings on branding, marketing, and web design services.
  • Flexible Collaboration: No upfront fees—just passion for creativity and networking.

Other Information:

  • Open to Creatives, Entrepreneurs, and Influencers looking to align with a premium branding and apparel brand.
  • Opportunities for Features on KHAI Designsz social media and website.
  • Networking & Community Access with like-minded creatives and business owners.

Ready to represent KHAI Designsz and unlock exclusive perks? Join the Ambassador Program today!
